title: Ram Teri Ganga Maili Actor Mandakini Mourns Father's Death, Shares Tribute: 'My Heart Is Shattered'
text:
Ram Teri Ganga Maili Actor Mandakini Mourns Father's Death, Shares Tribute: 'My Heart Is Shattered'
Mandakini Father Death: Ram Teri Ganga Maili actress Mandakini mourns her father’s death, shares heartfelt tribute on social media.
Mandakini Father Death: Veteran Bollywood actress Mandakini is grieving the loss of her father, who passed away on July 2. The actress, famous for her unforgettable role in the 1985 classic Ram Teri Ganga Maili, announced the sad news on social media, expressing her sorrow in a deeply emotional post.
Sharing a touching photo of her father on Instagram, Mandakini wrote, “My heart is shattered today… I lost my beloved father this morning. No words can express the pain of this goodbye. Thank you, Papa, for your endless love, wisdom, and blessings. You will forever live in my heart!" Her fans and followers responded with condolences and support, offering strength during her difficult time.
Recommended Stories
Mandakini rose to fame with Ram Teri Ganga Maili, directed by the legendary Raj Kapoor. While she acted in a handful of films afterwards, she eventually stepped away from the limelight.
Back in 2023, she appeared on The Kapil Sharma Shown the comedy chat show with actress Sangeeta Bijlani. Mandakini reacted to old rumours claiming that her father had “shot" her once. She expressed that she had no idea why everyone was so concerned about her when she reached the set of her project one day. “There was a news spread that my father shot me. When I reached the set, everybody came to me asking whether I was okay. I had no clue why they were all so concerned about me and later I came to know about the rumour," the actress was quoted as saying on the show by the Hindustan Times.
Mandakini has always been known for maintaining a personal life away from the media limelight. She is married to Dr Kagyur T Rinpoche Thakur, a former Buddhist monk, and the duo have a son and a daughter.
After Ram Teri Ganga Maili, Mandakini featured in a handful of films like Dance Dance, Kahan Hai Kanoon and Pyaar Karke Dekho. Her last Bollywood film was 1996’s Zordaar, directed by Ajay Kashyap.
Ram Teri Ganga Maili is a landmark 1985 Bollywood film directed by Raj Kapoor, known for its bold storytelling and beautiful portrayal of rural India. The film became a massive hit and made Mandakini a household name, thanks to her memorable performance as the innocent and spirited Ganga.
